name: Prize: The Abyss
description: Always dropped by a Hullbreaker, the giant of the Abyssal Chasm.

pages.title: Immortal Embryo
pages.text: Always dropped by a **Hullbreaker**, the giant of the Abyssal Chasm. It keeps the crew alive out there.

pages.title: Where
pages.text: The **Abyssal Chasm** is an [#](2E5AAC)[Alex's Caves](entry://exploration/alexs_caves)[#]() biome deep under ocean, pitch black and crushing. A [Cave Biome Map](item://alexscaves:cave_map) points to one. Go down in a [#](2E5AAC)[submarine](entry://ocean/submarines)[#](): it carries air, light and weapons.

pages.title: How
pages.text: Hullbreakers spawn there naturally, rarely. Underwater Mines and Depth Charges hit it from the safety of your hull. More will spawn if you need another.
